target_customer: Front-office sales reps and account executives at companies that run Salesforce
problem: Sales reps spend a large share of their week on CRM data entry, follow-up tracking and hunting for context across email, calendar and call notes, and the CRM data still ends up stale.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat (inferred from waitlist onboarding; pricing not found)
product_category: AI assistant for CRM updates, task management and search

competitors.name: Salesforce Einstein Copilot
competitors.what: Conversational AI assistant built into Salesforce, announced as a copilot for CRM apps
competitors.traction_then: announced Feb 2024, in beta; no customer numbers found

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with email, calendar, call recordings and Salesforce plus LLM drafting is standard engineering for a two person team in early 2024; no research-grade parts are described.

defensibility.rationale: The launch post says it layers onto Salesforce rather than replacing it, so it depends on Salesforce data access and could be copied by Salesforce itself or other AI CRM tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce announced Einstein Copilot in Feb 2024, the same month the company launched on YC; Salesforce later rebranded it into the Agentforce line per CX Today coverage.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites a claim that sales reps spend 30 to 50 percent of their time on admin work, and the founders had direct Salesforce sales engineer experience of the pain. No customer counts or revenue were found.

branding.domain_note: Website was crmcopilot.co, not a .com; the site returned 404 when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Launch copy is plain and empathetic about Salesforce fatigue, with a direct tagline: Give Salesforce the AI upgrade it deserves.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage of the brand was found. The name is a generic pairing of CRM and the widely used word copilot, and searches for it surface other products named Copilot CRM.

outcome_analysis: The company launched on YC in Winter 2024 with two to three founders and is now listed as Inactive. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned. Facts that bear on risk are that Salesforce announced its own Einstein Copilot in February 2024 and that the product depended on Salesforce data access.
notes: Funding: no round found. StartupHub showed an implausible $500M total, treated as an error and not recorded. Outcome search found nothing about this company (results were about Moonhub and Clockwise). Competitor list rests on one dated source; the launch post names only Salesforce. Company website returned HTTP 404, so the site is likely dead.
